guesses.reason: The soft, wavy-to-curly apricot coat and the long, fluffy hanging ears point strongly to poodle ancestry, as in a Cavapoo or Yorkipoo-type cross.
The scruffy, shaggy facial furnishings with a beard and eyebrows, the compact sturdy body, and the wheaten coloring suggest small terrier heritage.
The low-set, feathered drop ears and the soulful dark round eyes hint at some spaniel influence.

breed.appearance: Roger is a small, compact dog with a shaggy, wavy-to-curly coat in warm apricot-tan, slightly damp and tousled, with longer wispy fur forming a beard, mustache, and messy topknot. He has long, floppy, feathered drop ears, round dark brown eyes, and a prominent dark brown-black nose on a short, fuzzy muzzle. He wears a bright blue harness with a silver tag and sits looking up with a sweet, slightly tilted head.
breed.fun_fact: Poodle mixes like Roger are famously smart and eager to learn, so he could pick up new tricks faster than you can say 'treat!'
